Name: Unique Horses by CC
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][b][size=6]﻿Unique Horses by CC[/size][/b][/center]
                                                                                                                
[center][i]The goal is to offer a well-animated horse that is balanced and vanilla-friendly, while also visually compatible with other animal replacement mods.  Each breed of horse has been attentively hand-drawn to give them a unique-feeling personality.[/i][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=4]The 3.0 update is a regular-sized revamp of this mod! I had been planning this update as a holiday thank-you to the community, so please consider this an early THANK YOU! This is an incredibly cool community, and I hope these dancin' ponies suit your fancy. [/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=4]An especial thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51089711]khazhak[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35393]CC Style Donkeys [/url]and to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118430843]nugmod[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52208]CC's Style Unicorns [/url]for the beautiful spritework and inspiration to continue working on this mod. Your art helped push me to improve my own! The new Donkey and Pegasus colors are made to match your work.[/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[left][size=5][b]How to Use:[/b][/size][/left]
[left][list]
[*]Download ZIP and unzip into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Replace All as needed for updating[/*]
[*]Change config settings as desire[/*]
[/list][/left]
[center][/center]
[left][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] is highly recommended as the easiest way to adjust configs.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b]This mod has been tested mostly with:[/b][/left]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43745]Horse Follows You[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53548]Sweet Farmer[/url][/*]
[/list][center][/center]
[left][/left]
[left]This does mean that the new horses haven't been tested too extensively with either recolors or alt farmer bodies. Please let me know if you run into a conflict![/left]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][list]
[*][b][size=4]The AT version of this mod is no longer supported. It is CP-only as of 3.0[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=5][b]Known Issues:[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
These horses are taller than your average vanilla horse, which unfortunately means... they do not look good in hats.[/center]
[center]It is not recommended to put a hat on these unique horses :([/center]

[line]

[/center]
